business_review.text: Form validation errors announced by screen readers on the listed modals/pages (WCAG SC 4.1.3, SC 3.3.1) by aligning Input, Select, MultiSelect with Textarea pattern.
Computed ARIA values win over caller-supplied aria-invalid/aria-describedby.

standards_review.standard: git-workflow: EPMCDME-XXXX_ prefix on branch and commits
standards_review.notes: Branch EPMCDME-8489_a11y-form-error-live-region; all commits prefixed EPMCDME-8489:

finding_status.evidence: Input.tsx extracts callerDescribedBy from rest and computes describedBy as [callerDescribedBy, error ? errorId : undefined].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || undefined. Caller's aria-describedby is preserved (verified by two new tests: 'merges caller-supplied aria-describedby with the computed error id' and 'preserves a caller-supplied aria-describedby when there is no error'). form-patterns.md guide rewritten to describe the actual contract.

key={error} added to the role="alert" div in Input.tsx, Select.tsx, and MultiSelect.tsx. New Input rerender test asserts that when the error string transitions from 'Required' to 'Must be at least 3 characters', the queried alert element identity changes (secondAlert !== firstAlert), confirming the div is re-mounted so screen readers re-announce.

rationale: Both patch-class findings resolved with targeted, surgical changes; all 28 unit tests in the touched surface remain green. Fix-up diff (5 files, 49 insertions) introduces no new high-risk issue in security, public API, data loss, or build/runtime correctness — no confirmation pass required.
